settings.label: Product placeholder image
settings.info: The default for a product with no image: cards, product page, cart and favorites. A "Product placeholder" entry in Content > Metaobjects can choose another image by product type and vendor. Leave empty for a plain neutral block. Use the same shape as your product images (4:5 works best).

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square PNG, at least 48x48px.

settings.label: Social profile URLs
settings.info: One full URL per line (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and so on). Shown as links in the footer, named after the network, and published as schema.org sameAs on the home page.

settings.content: Only fonts from Shopify's font library are available. They are served from Shopify's CDN and match checkout. Body text loads weights 400 and 600.

settings.label: Monospace accents
settings.info: Used for prices, labels, SKUs and metadata. The default system monospace font costs zero bytes.

settings.label: Hide .00 on whole prices
settings.info: Shows $79 instead of $79.00. Prices with cents, like $79.50, keep them. Structured data for search engines always keeps the decimals.

settings.label: Let shoppers zoom product images
settings.info: Each image on the product page opens full screen with its description and, when it belongs to variants, which ones. Loads one small script on product pages only.

settings.label: Play a short video preview when a product card is hovered or focused
settings.info: For products that have a video uploaded to Shopify. Nothing is downloaded until then. Touch screens and visitors who prefer reduced motion see the picture only.

settings.label: Show the cart in a drawer
settings.info: The cart opens beside the page from the header cart link and after an add to cart. The cart page stays the fallback and the place with favorites. Loads one small script on every page.

settings.label: Show a quick add button on product cards
settings.info: A shopping cart button on the image of products with one variant that are in stock. Products with options have no button: choosing options needs the product page.

settings.label: Let shoppers choose options from product cards
settings.info: A shopping cart button on the image of in-stock products with options opens a dialog with the option picker, quantity and Add to cart. Without JavaScript the button is a link to the product page. Loads two small scripts on pages with product cards.

settings.label: Show the product type above the title on product cards
settings.info: Uses the Type set on each product in the Shopify admin. Products without a type show nothing.

settings.label: Show percentage off on discounted prices
Product image format
settings.info: Every product image (cards, product page, cart, search, quick add) is cropped to this shape, so a page never mixes shapes. Square is what Meta's catalog and Shopify's own guidance use, and Google Merchant Center accepts it. Portrait suits clothing and tall packaging, landscape suits furniture and wide goods. Upload your images in the same shape to avoid crops.

settings.label: Link products from a collection with the collection in the URL
settings.info: A product opened from a collection page gets /collections/<collection>/products/<product>, so its breadcrumb shows the collection the shopper came from, even when the product is in several. Search engines are pointed to the plain /products/ address (the canonical), so nothing is duplicated for them. Off: every product link is the same everywhere.

settings.label: Breadcrumb menu
settings.info: A collection nested under another item in this menu gets that item as its parent in breadcrumbs (up to three levels). Collection metafields override it. Leave empty to use the metafields only.

settings.content: Soft navigation swaps only the main content area and keeps the header and footer mounted. It does not run Shopify's page-load analytics or consent hooks, so verify your tracking before enabling it.

settings.label: Prefetch links (Chromium)
settings.info: Ignored when soft navigation is on, which prefetches on its own.

settings.content: GA4 ecommerce events pushed to the dataLayer: page_view, view_item_list, select_item, view_item, add_to_cart, remove_from_cart, view_cart, view_search_results, generate_lead. Checkout events (begin_checkout to purchase) come from the Customer Events pixel in scripts/pixels. Off by default; nothing is rendered or loaded when off.

settings.label: GA4 measurement ID (used only without a GTM ID)
Load GTM or gtag
settings.info: After interaction keeps Lighthouse clean but loses sessions that never interact.

options.label: Google Consent Mode v2, driven by Shopify Customer Privacy

settings.label: Show the theme's cookie dialog
settings.info: A cookie dialog in the theme's own look, using Shopify's customer privacy settings and Customer Privacy API: it asks only visitors in the regions you set in Settings > Customer privacy, and records the answer there. Turn Shopify's own cookie banner off first (remove it under Settings > Customer privacy > Cookie banner, where available), or visitors see two. Adds a Cookie settings link to the footer. Needs JavaScript. To review it, add ?consent_preview to any page address: it shows the dialog and records nothing.

settings.label: Log events to the browser console
Consent note
settings.info: Shown under every signup form: say what the subscriber agrees to and link your privacy policy. What you must say depends on your markets, and this is not legal advice. Leave empty to show nothing.

settings.label: Ask visitors to tick a box
settings.info: Turns the consent note into an unticked checkbox that must be ticked before the form can be sent, for markets that need an explicit opt-in. Needs a consent note.

settings.label: Confirmation message
settings.info: Shown after signing up. Change it if you turned on double opt-in (Settings > Notifications in the Shopify admin), for example to ask visitors to check their email. Leave empty for the standard message.

settings.label: Enable favorites
settings.info: Saved per device in the browser (localStorage) and shown on the cart page. No account needed.

settings.label: Show a heart on product cards
settings.info: Adds one button per card. Turn off to keep grids as light as possible; the product page button stays.

settings.label: Enable the component library page
settings.info: Developer tool for the page template page.styleguide: every component, an accessibility audit and live measurements. Renders nothing when off. Keep off on production stores.
